requirements: Extend notice dispatch to batch transport calls and keep undelivered work queued after temporary transport unavailability (ConnectionError). Preserve the scheduler command interface. Queue entries smaller than one batch must also be delivered when explicitly flushed. Invalid transport payloads must remain visible to the caller as ValueError. Transport.send accepts a list and succeeds atomically or raises.
